{{Quote|I have to admit, I always thought X-3 would be the one. He seemed somehow&hellip;impervious.|Rezi Soresh to X-7|<ref name="Target" />}}
'''X-3''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Target" /> [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who, along with six other men, was hired to participate in [[Project Omega]]. The operation was an experiment by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]] to create the perfect assassin who would then go on to serve the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Soresh wiped the participants' identities from a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] database system and had their faces surgically altered. Soresh put them through a brutal reconditioning program, which was designed to turn them into mindless servants by removing their memories and emotions.<ref name="Trapped">''[[Rebel Force: Trapped]]''</ref>

At first, X-3 became friends with [[X-1 (assassin)|X-1]], [[X-2]], [[X-4]], [[X-5]], [[X-6]], and [[X-7]], the other participants in the training program. However, after Soresh started torturing them with [[Torture/Legends|electrocution]], X-3, like everyone else, had his personality and [[Brain/Legends|mind]] changed completely until he felt no emotions.<ref name="Target" /> Around [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the would-be assassins were pitted against each other until only one remained. Despite X-3 being Soresh's personal favorite to win, X-7 [[Death/Legends|killed]] X-3 with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] and earned the right to become Soresh's personal assassin.<ref name="Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
X-3 first appeared in a flashback sequence in ''[[Rebel Force: Target]]'', the first book of the young readers series ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Force]]'', published in [[2008]] and written by [[Alex Wheeler]].<ref name="Target" />
